units.source_text: 忽然体重消失了，浮在了半空中……

en.t: Suddenly his weight vanished, and he was floating in midair...

units.source_text: 晕船般的感觉，唰地穿过全身，

en.t: A seasick feeling swept sharply through his whole body,

units.source_text: 刚才扯着手上皮肤往上拖的绳索，现在毫无抵抗地留在了手里。

en.t: The rope that had just been dragging him upward, pulling at the skin of his hands, now lay in his hands without the slightest resistance.
